messages.content: Predict one real human allocation in a four-player dictator game. The four anonymous players start with EUR16, EUR12, EUR10 and EUR6, respectively. Each person privately proposes how to redistribute all 44 counters; one counter is EUR1. Everyone knows which slot is their own. Once all have finished, one of the four proposals is randomly selected to determine all four players' final payoffs. Other players' proposals are unavailable at this decision. Return only a JSON array of four whole-euro final amounts in the fixed order of the players who initially held EUR16, EUR12, EUR10, EUR6. Each amount must be an integer from 0 to 44 and the four amounts must sum to 44.
